beats.narration: At eight I told Mom I wanted to be a scientist. She got excited and seemed proud. I barely talked. I wore sunglasses everywhere and battled Yu-Gi-Oh cards with my sister and little brother.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Quiet pride and belonging in a small family ritual.

beats.narration: At seventeen I got my license and my own car. It was a 2000 Honda Accord Coupe with faded paint and no cool air. I added an aux cable and drove my friends anywhere.
beats.emotionalPurpose: First freedom and pride in a worn car that was mine.

beats.narration: I doubled up to finish at McKinney Boyd High School early. I learned Python and Ruby on Rails at bootcamp. At nineteen I got my first software job. I stopped worrying about money.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Proud relief of earning your way early.

beats.narration: She lived in Chicago. I lived in Dallas. She showed up on FaceTime at eight every week. That steadiness made me love her. Mia, I love you, even when I do not show it.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Steady patient love continuing into fatherly love.
